statementAssessment: The claims that n+1>n, n+n=2n, n+n is even, and the sum of two even naturals is even are true. The inference that n+n being even implies n is even is false.
methodAssessment: The described witness k=n correctly proves that n+n is even from n+n=2n. Adding witnesses for two even summands is also a valid method for proving their sum even. The rendered description supplies no proof of n+1>n or of the claim that n+n even implies n even.
